title: Blanton's background with Fate Marable and how Duke found him
summary: They try to recall how Ellington discovered Blanton in St. Louis.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Do you know how old he was when he went from violin to bass?
Oh, he must have been very young, because he was only 24 when he died.
I know. You don't remember him telling you how long he'd been playing bass?

Well, I think he'd been playing bass probably over ten years or so when he went with Duke. Because prior to that he played with Fate Marable. Everybody who's heard of the riverboats has heard of Fate Marable. I've never met him, but Blanton played with him for a period. And I'm not sure whether Duke discovered him in St. Louis or where it was. Do you know?
Yes. I would know if I went and checked it out. It was...let's see, Ben Webster and who was it... One of the oral histories I did.
No, I didn't do one with Ben. But he said, whoever it was, he and Ben heard him and took Duke to hear him in Kansas City... [SIC: St. Louis]
Yes. And Duke got to hear this kid play.
